doc.title: Ed Shaughnessy Part I interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 1, 1995 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Playing behind Joe Williams on the Tonight Show
summary: He often accompanied Joe Williams, a popular guest on Carson's show, and is fond of him.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: I’ll bet. Did you ever have an opportunity to play behind Joe Williams?

I played behind Joe a great deal on the Tonight Show. Not with the Basie band because he wasn’t with the Basie band at that time. But I played for Joe a lot. Because he was a very popular guest on the Carson show. I think, if you ask Joe, I don’t think it’s an © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -14-

exaggeration to say Joe could do, easily, four shots a year, if not more on the Carson show, for quite a few years. So we worked together a lot. I’ve very fond of Joe. He’s a great guy. Wonderful person.
